responseMessageContents.text:
The Google Maps JavaScript API error occurs on web because react-native-maps uses Google Maps on web and requires an API key. The app already has a fallback for when MapView is not available, but on web, react-native-maps might partially load and trigger the Google Maps API error.

The fix is to skip react-native-maps on web and show the fallback UI instead.

The error occurs because `react-native-maps` tries to load Google Maps JavaScript API on web without a valid API key. The fix is to skip loading `react-native-maps` on web and show the fallback UI instead.

The fix is applied. On web, `react-native-maps` will no longer attempt to load the Google Maps JavaScript API, and the fallback UI (showing your summit list) will display instead. The native map will continue to work normally on iOS and Android devices.

responseMessageContents.title: Fix an error with the map when viewing the app on the web.
responseMessageContents.description: Improved the map feature to prevent a technical error from appearing when using the app in a web browser, while ensuring it still works on mobile devices.
